reading: Many huge data centres are planned for Scotland.
These centres help with online tasks like bank payments or using AI.
From the outside, data centres look like a factory.
Inside, thousands of computers work and make noise.
Supporters say data centres can bring jobs and investment.
But opponents worry about the energy they use and their size.
Scotland has strong renewable energy, which data centres need.
However, some centres might use fossil fuels if there is not enough wind power.
